message.content: In the conversation, Fionnuala mentions that the Control Center makes switching between games and apps much smoother, which Ileana appreciates as well. Specifically, Fionnuala states, "The Control Center is awesome! I especially love how you can adjust audio settings on the fly without having to pause the game. Makes it so convenient when you're in the heat of action!" This indicates that the Control Center is the feature praised for improving convenience and fluidity when transitioning between applications on the PS5.
